name: Istanbul and Cappadocia Tour – 6 Days Turkey Package

itinerary.description: Optional morning balloon ride, then hiking in Red Valley, visit to Kaymakli Underground City, and evening flight back to Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Free Day & Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast at hotel, free time until airport transfer for your international departure.
